# Data Source: yet_cloud_namespace

A namespace — a group of applications — by its name or its id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By its name…
data "yet_cloud_namespace" "shop" {
  name = "Shop"
}

# …or by its id.
data "yet_cloud_namespace" "billing" {
  id = "ns_1"
}
```
